title: 256 14-round RGMS22: aes256-14r-related-key-characteristic-rgms2022

target.description: Author-reported Rijndael-128-256 (standard AES dimensions) Table 3, 14 rounds. Section 2 states initial AddRoundKey and no final MixColumns; Tables 3/4 include last-round subkey S-boxes. Pinned source-code inspection reconciles printed schedule-indexing typos; no independent search reproduction.

setting.key_relation: XOR-related master-key pair, with round-key differences constrained by the source AES/Rijndael key-schedule model.
setting.plaintext_model: Nontrivial related-key differential characteristics over source state and key-schedule differences; no attack-query budget is claimed.
assumptions: The source Markov/round-independence assumption is used for the multiplicative S-box characteristic weight.
o1 is the Step1 truncated-model lower bound; o2 counts active S-boxes in the maximum-weight instantiated characteristic, including state and key schedule.

Printed pseudocode/indexing inconsistencies were independently checked against pinned author AfricaCrypt22 commit5c76954038191d9d9b65bea7cbbda1c613b2ee3b and PhD-Core64511a3e87ab238bdc71ceaa74158d22a04df634; correct Nk-based/same-row recurrence and key-Sbox ranges occur in inspected code. Solver output/optimality not independently reproduced.

limitations: Tables 3/4 and Figure 1 use different last-subkey S-box accounting. The source cites AES-192 seven-round 2^-84 versus earlier 2^-78; this is a model-accounting change, not a same-model attack improvement. Pinned author-code inspection resolves the printed recurrence/range discrepancies as transcription/model-presentation issues; not a verified solver certificate.

property.statement: The reported 14-round AES-256 related-key characteristic has source-model maximum product weight p=2^-146 and o1=o2=24 active S-boxes across state and key schedule.
property.quantifier: Optimization over the source nontrivial related-key byte-difference characteristic model, not maximum differential-hull probability or a per-fixed-key success guarantee.
property.scope: Exactly Table 3 Clen=128,Klen=256,Nr=14. Search CPU seconds and 16GB RAM are experiment resources, not online attack costs.
